王野回到家时已经快九点了，院子里的人都已经睡了，现在的人可没有多少夜间娱乐活动，除了造小人就早早的睡了，回到自己屋，看边上的王江河已经呼呼大睡了，王野也就简单洗漱了一下上炕了。

精神力进入空间，看见地里的农作物都已经成熟了，王野立刻用精神力把所有的农作物收好，土豆和红薯都有一亩了，空间中的产量相当不错。

土豆亩产五千多斤，取出一半留种继续种下，这一次就种了十亩，红薯也挑选出十亩地的秧苗种下，经过这次留种，王野的土豆和红薯完全可以自由了，种完后还剩下红薯五千多斤土豆，因为留种就剩下两千五百多斤了。

王野又统计了一下玉米、小麦和花生，这两样是在老家偷拿的，每样只有一把，因为每亩用种的数量不同，种的亩数也不一样，这都是王野在老家与爷爷闲聊时知道的。

因为拿种子时时间仓促，每样只拿了一把，大概都是只有三两的样子，所以第一次种的面积也就不同。

爷爷说小麦每亩需要20斤种子，玉米需要六斤就够，花生得用三十斤，所以那次王野玉米只种了半分（1市亩＝10分＝666.7平米）这次收获了七十多斤，小麦只种了十来平方也就不到五十分之一亩，这次只产了二十斤，花生更惨，只种了百分之一亩收了15斤。

王野也没想这几样也能自由，就又把收获的产物全当种子又种上了，忙活到半夜，最后看着空间里玉米种了十亩，小麦种了一亩，花生最惨稀稀拉拉的才种够一亩。王野看着这些农作物，美滋滋的想着，再有十天，自己就可以粮食自由了。

王野一直怀念前世的大白面馒头，和大米饭，想起大米饭，王野就开始琢磨，怎么种点儿稻子。稻子从哪儿找点种子呢？慢慢的思考一会儿，猛的想起，前世某音上卖大米的说的胚芽米和精米，胚芽米当时还很贵呢！精米...现在这个时代哪儿有精米呀？都是糙米，糙米不就是胚芽米吗！

玛德自己手里是有大米的，怎么前几天没种呢，浪费了这么久的时间，想完立刻就行动，在空间里找到大米，这些大米不少，但是在王野细看之后发现有很多都破损了，王野用精神力挑出可以完整且饱满的，数量不少足足有三十斤，王野立刻把这三十斤种子种上，差不多种了五亩。

看看时间十二点多了，白天睡了一上午明天又是周末，现在也不困闲着也是闲着，不如去鸽子市转一圈，王野下床直接出门，聂声聂脚的走出大门，赵爷爷又醒了，互相咳嗽了一声算是打过招呼了。

一路无事，来到鸽子市，王野直接在门口问看门的：“龙哥在吗？”

看门的见王野是找龙哥的，就客气的问：“兄弟是哪位，找龙哥什么事儿？”

王野直接说：“昨天龙哥说有好东西直接来找他，这不是今天就来了。”

看门的两个人互相看了一眼，一人说：“稍等一下！”然后转身进了破巷子里。没一会儿，刚进去的人就带着龙哥和昨天的大个子大强出来了。

龙哥紧走两步上前说：“兄弟，动作挺快呀！昨天刚说今天就又搞到野猪了。”

王野说：“野猪没搞到，搞到点红薯和土豆要不要？”

龙哥有点不太高兴的心想：“这要是有肉还行，整点红薯和土豆还来找我，是不是太不把我当回事儿？”

但还是耐心的问：“兄弟有多少呀？”

王野随意的说：“四千斤红薯，两千斤土豆”

龙哥也没走心：“也没多少呀！”

然后猛的睁开睡眼朦胧的眼：“多少？兄弟你刚才说多少？”

王野又重复了一遍：“四千斤红薯，两千斤土豆。”

龙哥缓了一下心情说：“兄弟，这可不能开玩笑呀！虽说现在土豆和红薯不算粮食，但是这也最好的替代粮了。”

“放心吧！龙哥，我还没有那么大胆子，到你地盘来逗你玩儿。”

龙哥跃跃欲试的问：“兄弟，那东西在哪儿？”

王野指着不远处的小树林：“在小树林里，有村民看着。”

龙哥：“那兄弟是想怎样交易？想卖多少钱一斤？”

王野：“龙哥，价格吗！市面上土豆四毛红薯三毛二，咱也是熟人了，我给你们土豆三毛二，红薯两毛四，怎么样？”

龙哥满意的说：“行！兄弟，讲究！那哥哥就先谢谢你了！”

It was almost nine o'clock when Wang Ye returned home. Everyone in the yard was already asleep. People nowadays don't have many nighttime entertainment activities. They went to bed early except making little figures. When he returned to his room, he saw that Wang Jianghe was fast asleep next to him, so Wang Ye simply washed himself and got on the kang.

When his mental power entered the space, he saw that the crops in the field were all mature. Wang Ye immediately used his mental power to harvest all the crops. There were one acre of potatoes and sweet potatoes, and the yield in the space was quite good.

Potatoes yield more than 5,000 kilograms per mu. Half of the seeds were taken out and planted again. Ten acres were planted this time. Sweet potatoes were also planted with seedlings from ten acres of land. After this seed saving, Wang Ye's potatoes and sweet potatoes were completely free. After planting, there were still more than 5,000 kilograms of sweet potatoes and potatoes, because more than 2,500 kilograms of sweet potatoes were left after the seeds were left.

Wang Ye also counted corn, wheat and peanuts. These two were stolen from his hometown. There was only a handful of each. Because the number of seeds per acre is different, the number of acres planted is also different. Wang Ye knew this when chatting with his grandfather in his hometown.

Because I was in a hurry when I got the seeds, I only got a handful of each, probably only three taels, so the area planted for the first time was different.

Grandpa said that wheat requires 20 kilograms of seeds per acre, corn requires 6 kilograms, and peanuts require 30 kilograms, so Wang Ye only planted half a cent of corn that time (1 mu = 10 cents = 666.7 square meters). This time, he harvested more than 70 kilograms. Wheat was only planted on ten square meters, which is less than one-fiftieth of an acre. This time, only 20 kilograms were produced. Peanuts were even worse. They only planted one percent of an acre and harvested 15 kilograms.

Wang Ye didn't think that he could be free in these ways, so he used all the harvested products as seeds and planted them again. He worked until midnight. Finally, he looked at the space where ten acres of corn had been planted, one acre of wheat, and only one acre of peanuts, which was the most sparse.Wang Ye looked at these crops and thought happily that in ten days, he would be able to have food freedom.

Wang Ye has always missed the white flour steamed buns and rice in his previous life. Thinking of rice, Wang Ye began to think about how to grow some rice.Where can I find some seeds for rice?After thinking about it slowly for a while, I suddenly remembered that in my previous life, a rice seller on a certain video talked about germ rice and polished rice. Germ rice was still very expensive at that time!Polished rice...where can you find polished rice in this day and age?They are all brown rice, and isn’t brown rice just germ rice?

Ma De had rice in his hand. Why didn't he plant it a few days ago? After wasting so long, he immediately took action and found rice in the space. There was a lot of rice, but after Wang Ye took a closer look, he found that many of them were damaged. Wang Ye used his mental power to pick out the ones that were complete and full. There were quite a lot of thirty kilograms. Wang Ye immediately planted these thirty kilograms of seeds, covering almost five acres.

Look at the time, it's past twelve o'clock. I slept all morning and tomorrow is the weekend again. I'm not tired now and have nothing to do. Why not go to the pigeon market for a walk? Wang Ye got out of bed and went straight out. He walked out of the door with a loud voice. Grandpa Zhao woke up again and coughed to each other as a greeting.

The journey was uneventful. When they arrived at Pigeon Market, Wang Ye asked the doorman directly at the door: "Is Brother Long here?"

When the gatekeeper saw that Wang Ye was looking for Brother Long, he asked politely: "Who is this brother? What do you want to see Brother Long for?"

Wang Ye said directly: "Brother Long said yesterday that he had something good to come directly to him, but it didn't just come today."

The two gatekeepers looked at each other, and one of them said, "Wait a minute!" Then he turned and entered the dilapidated alley.After a while, the people who had just entered came out with Brother Long and yesterday's big man Daqiang.

Brother Long took two steps forward and said, "Brother, you are moving very fast! I just said yesterday that we will get another wild boar today."

Wang Ye said: "We didn't get the wild boar. Do you want some sweet potatoes and potatoes?"

Brother Long was a little unhappy and thought to himself: "It would be okay if it had meat. If you still come to me with some sweet potatoes and potatoes, do you think you don't take me seriously?"

But he still asked patiently: "How many brothers do you have?"

Wang Ye said casually: "Four thousand catties of sweet potatoes, two thousand catties of potatoes."

Brother Long was not distracted either: "It's not much!"

Then he suddenly opened his sleepy eyes: "How much? Brother, how much did you just say?"

Wang Ye repeated again: "Four thousand catties of sweet potatoes, two thousand catties of potatoes."

Brother Long calmed down and said, "Brother, this is no joke! Although potatoes and sweet potatoes are not considered food now, they are also the best alternative food."

"Don't worry! Brother Long, I'm not so bold as to come to your territory to tease you."

Brother Long asked eagerly: "Brother, where is that thing?"

Wang Ye pointed to the grove not far away: "In the grove, there are villagers watching."

Brother Long: "How do you want to trade, brother? How much do you want to sell a pound?"

Wang Ye: "Brother Long, what's the price? On the market, potatoes cost 40 cents and sweet potatoes cost 32 cents. We are already acquaintances. I'll give you potatoes 32 cents and sweet potatoes 24 cents. How about that?"

Brother Long said with satisfaction: "Okay! Brother, be particular! Then I'll thank you first!"
